title: About
description: About the artist, and where to find their work.

text: This is an artstream I created to explore the idea of failure as something to be embraced and encouraged rather than feared. Could the pursuit of failure even become a kind of artistic conceptual medium?
I am hesitant to say much more as it could diminish the project
